import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the relevant columns for documentation methods
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',

    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Convert the documentation methods to numeric values (assuming they are on a scale from 1 to 5)
for col in documentation_columns:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values
df = df.dropna(subset=documentation_columns)

# Calculate the frequency of each documentation method
documentation_frequencies = df[documentation_columns].sum()

# Bootstrap the frequencies to assess statistical significance
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((df[documentation_columns].values,), statistic='mean', confidence_level=0.95)

import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the relevant columns for documentation methods
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Replace '-77' with NaN to indicate missing data
df[documentation_columns] = df[documentation_columns].replace('-77', pd.NA)

# Count the number of 'quoted' responses for each documentation method
documentation_usage = df[documentation_columns].apply(lambda x: x.value_counts().get('quoted', 0))

# Create a contingency table
contingency_table = pd.DataFrame({
    'User_Stories': [63],
    'Other_Methods': [sum(documentation_usage) - 63]
})

# Perform the chi-squared test
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)

chi2, p
